intro: Between April and June 2026, ZCyberNews covered 13 espionage-focused incidents, with APT28 (Fancy Bear), APT37, and CL-STA-1062 emerging as the top threat actors. These campaigns primarily targeted government, defense, healthcare, technology, and banking sectors across Europe, Southeast Asia, South Korea, Ukraine, and Asia. The severity mix included 11 high-severity and 2 critical-severity events, reflecting sustained cyber espionage activity against strategic global interests.
